Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GS.
We delivered record revenue of $37.7 billion this quarter, representing 24% year-over-year growth.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2019.
Our gross margin expanded by 174 basis points to 72.4%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 24% to 14% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.89 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 174 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
